words.example: All staff adhere to the handwash rule.
words.exampleZh: 所有人員都遵守洗手規定。
words.notes: adhere to 是遵守某規定。形容詞是 adhesive。

words.example: A second test is advisable.
words.notes: wise 與 reasonable 近義。

words.example: I advise a second opinion.
words.exampleZh: 我勸你再問一次其他醫師。
words.notes: advise sb to do 是勸某人做。名詞是 advice。

words.example: They may amputate below the knee.
words.exampleZh: 他們可能從膝蓋以下截除。
words.notes: 名詞 amputation 是截肢手術。amputee 是被截肢者。

words.example: The anesthetist stays through the case.
words.exampleZh: 麻醉醫師會全程留在手術裡。
words.notes: anesthetic 是麻醉的。拼法用美式 anesthetist。

words.example: Keep the field aseptic.
words.notes: sterile 與 germfree 近義。

words.example: The backache started after the lift.
words.notes: cure a backache 是治療背痛。

words.example: A clot blocked the vein.
words.notes: blood clot 是血塊。heart clot 是心臟血栓。也可作動詞，表示凝結。

words.example: The chart is too complicated to read fast.
words.exampleZh: 這份病歷複雜到無法快速看完。
words.notes: detailed 與 sophisticated 近義。

words.example: She kept her composure during the news.
words.exampleZh: 聽到消息時她仍保持鎮定。
words.notes: maintain composure 是保持鎮定。regain composure 是恢復鎮定。

words.example: She had three consecutive nights of fever.
words.notes: successive 與 continuous 近義。

words.example: Rest alone will not cure the infection.
words.exampleZh: 只靠休息治不好這個感染。
words.notes: 主詞可以是人、藥或療法。受詞是人或疾病。

words.example: The dental visit is on Friday.
words.notes: dental caries 是蛀牙。dental surgery 是牙科手術。

words.example: The dentin is exposed.
words.notes: secondary dentin 是次級牙本質。拼法用 dentin。

words.example: The dentist sees her twice a year.
words.notes: general dentist 是全科牙醫。thoughtful dentist 是細心的牙醫。

words.example: Disinfect the tray between patients.
words.exampleZh: 兩位病人之間要把托盤消毒。
words.notes: 可用於被動。The knife was disinfected. 是這把刀已消毒。

words.example: The doctor wants a new film.
words.notes: 可數。call in a doctor 與 send for a doctor 都是去請醫師。

words.example: The enamel is thin on that tooth.
words.notes: 其他領域也可指瓷漆或漆皮。

words.example: They extract the tooth this afternoon.
words.exampleZh: 他們今天下午拔那顆牙。
words.notes: extract from 是從某處取出。也可表示提取。

words.example: Sign the form before the scan.
words.exampleZh: 掃描前先在表格上簽名。
words.notes: 作名詞也可指形式，various forms 是各種形式。作動詞是形成。

words.example: A geneticist reviewed the sample.
words.exampleZh: 一位遺傳學家看過這份檢體。
words.notes: genetic 是遺傳的。

words.example: The heartbeat is uneven.
words.notes: irregular heartbeat 是心律不整。

words.example: The old method is impotent against this strain.
words.exampleZh: 舊方法對這個菌株無能為力。
words.notes: 這裡多指無力應付。也可作抽象用法。

words.example: We can infer a clot from the swelling.
words.exampleZh: 從腫脹可以推斷有血塊。
words.notes: infer from 是從某處推斷。infer that 是推斷某事。

words.example: They infuse the drug slowly.
words.notes: 可接 into。也可表示灌輸。

words.example: The infusion runs for one hour.
words.notes: infusion outfit 是輸液管組。

words.example: They inject the drug into a vein.
words.notes: inject sb with sth 是給某人注射某物。

words.example: The injection is due at noon.
words.notes: get an injection 是接受注射。give sb an injection 是給某人打針。

words.example: Do not interfere with the dressing.
words.notes: interfere with 是妨礙或干預某事。

words.example: The pain is intermittent.
words.notes: desultory 是不連貫的。on-again 可形容斷斷續續。

words.example: The intern presents the case at dawn.
words.exampleZh: 實習醫師天亮時報告這個病例。
words.notes: trainee 與 probationer 都可指實習中的人。

words.example: Do not intrude on the exam.
words.notes: intrude on 是闖入或把某事強加在某人身上。

words.example: Harsh soap can irritate the skin.
words.exampleZh: 刺激性肥皂會讓皮膚不舒服。
words.notes: 也可指言語惹怒人。anger 近義。motivate 是激起。

words.example: The ward will isolate the new case.
words.exampleZh: 病房會把這個新病例隔離。
words.notes: be isolated from 是與他人隔開。作形容詞時是獨立的、單獨的。

words.example: A short jog is allowed after week two.
words.exampleZh: 第二週之後可以短距離慢跑。
words.notes: 也可表示輕推。jog backwards 是往後跑。

words.example: The new lifestyle cuts the late meals.
words.exampleZh: 新的生活方式把宵夜減掉了。
words.notes: healthy lifestyle 是健康的生活方式。unhealthy lifestyle 是不健康的生活方式。

words.example: A medico sat in on the round.
words.notes: 也可泛指醫師。複數是 medicos。

words.example: A calm mentality helps the long stay.
words.exampleZh: 平靜的心態有助於長期住院。
words.notes: negative mentality 是負面心態。herd mentality 是從眾心理。

words.example: The toe shows necrosis.
words.notes: thanatosis 是假死。mortification 在此可指壞疽。

words.example: Keep the child under observation overnight.
words.notes: his observation 是他的觀察所見。

words.example: The obsession with the scale is new.
words.exampleZh: 對體重計的癡迷是最近才有的。
words.notes: overcome an obsession 是克服執念。

words.example: The oncologist changed the dose.
words.notes: medical oncologist 是腫瘤內科醫師。surgical oncologist 是腫瘤外科醫師。

words.example: Please open the chart.
words.notes: 作形容詞是開著的。

words.example: A specialist will operate in the morning.
words.notes: operate on 是為某人動手術。也可表示操作。

words.example: The operation lasts about two hours.
words.notes: heavy operation 是大手術。也可指操作或經營。

words.example: The extra scan is optional.
words.notes: selectable 與 elective 近義。

words.example: The organ was not harmed.
words.notes: organ transplant 是器官移植。也可指機構。

words.example: The cause is organic, not a mood.
words.exampleZh: 原因是器質性的，不是情緒。
words.notes: organic disease 是器官疾病。也可指有機的。

words.example: The overview fits on one page.
words.exampleZh: 這份概觀一頁就寫得下。
words.notes: cancer overview 是癌症概述。也可指市場概況。

words.example: I owe the clear scan to an early test.
words.exampleZh: 掃描清楚，要歸功於提早檢查。
words.notes: owe sth to 是把某事歸功於。不用被動。也可表示欠或感激。

words.example: Pain perception differs widely.
words.notes: visual perception 是視覺。depth perception 是深度知覺。

words.example: The perceptive nurse caught the change.
words.exampleZh: 這位有洞察力的護理師發現了變化。
words.notes: sensory 是感覺的。apperceptive 是感知的。

words.example: The physician adjusted the dose.
words.notes: family physician 是家庭醫師。physician in charge 是主治醫師。

words.example: The plasma bag is labeled.
words.notes: plasma storage 是血漿庫存。plasma exchange 是血漿置換。

words.example: Rough handling can provoke a spasm.
words.notes: 也可指激怒。provoke sb to do 是激得某人去做。

words.example: They will pull the dressing off slowly.
words.exampleZh: 他們會慢慢把敷料拉下來。
words.notes: 也可表示扯或拖。

words.example: The pulse is fast and thin.
words.notes: feel sb's pulse 是為某人診脈。作動詞是跳動。

words.example: The radiologist read the film.
words.exampleZh: 放射科醫師看了這張片子。
words.notes: oral radiologist 是口腔放射學家。dental radiologist 是牙科放射學家。

words.example: A reckless dose can harm the liver.
words.notes: impetuous 與 thoughtless 近義。

words.example: The tablet will relax the muscle.
words.notes: 後可接人或身體部位。

words.example: This remedy is only for mild pain.
words.exampleZh: 這個療法只用於輕微疼痛。
words.notes: beyond remedy 是無藥可救。remedy for 是針對某病的方法。

words.example: He is reticent about the pain.
words.notes: silent 與 voiceless 近義。

words.example: Many patients revere the night staff.
words.exampleZh: 許多病人崇敬夜班人員。
words.notes: 多用於較正式的敬意。少用於被動。

words.example: Rinse with warm salt water tonight.
words.notes: rinse out 是沖洗掉。作名詞是漱口或漂洗。

words.example: The scalpel is on the tray.
words.notes: laser scalpel 是雷射手術刀。

words.example: She left the sickbed for a chair.
words.notes: sickbed patient 是病床上的病人。sickbed call 是病床呼叫。

words.example: The surgeon starts at seven.
words.notes: surgical 是外科的。surgically 是以外科方式。

words.example: Family waits outside the surgery.
words.notes: 也可指手術本身。perform surgery 是進行外科手術。

words.example: They suture the cut in two layers.
words.exampleZh: 他們把傷口分兩層縫合。
words.notes: stitching 與 seaming 近義。

words.example: Please touch only the rail.
words.notes: 作名詞也可指聯繫。get in touch 是取得聯繫。

words.example: They may transfuse if the count stays low.
words.exampleZh: 如果指數一直偏低，他們可能輸血。
words.notes: direct transfusion 是直接輸血。exchange transfusion 是換血。

words.example: They treat the cough with rest.
words.exampleZh: 他們用休息來醫治咳嗽。
words.notes: 後可接人、病或 as 片語。treat sb to 是款待。

words.example: A short walk keeps the ankle loose.
words.exampleZh: 短距離散步能讓腳踝不僵。
words.notes: take a walk 與 go for a walk 都是去散步。

words.example: The weight is down two kilos.
words.notes: lose weight 是減重。gain weight 是增重。也可指重量。
